entries.sql: UPDATE DataQuest SET TargetName = replace(TargetName, 'Gris;101', 'Dahn;100'), StepText = replace(StepText, 'to the smith (Audliten or Huginfell) to craft an amulet.', 'to Dahn, the smith in Audliten, to craft an amulet.') WHERE ID = 21256
entries.why: the step sent the player to 'the smith (Audliten or Huginfell)' but the target was Gris in Jordheim; the period smith is Dahn in Audliten, who exists in our world
entries.source: Allakhazam quest 693 Price of Excellence: 'bring them to a smith (may be Dahn in Audliten or the smith in Huginfel)'; CapnBry radar: Dahn, East Svealand 3732,24268 (our row)

entries.why: the marker follows the smith to Dahn in Audliten

entries.sql: UPDATE DataQuest SET StartName = 'Nanna', TargetName = replace(TargetName, 'Anya Vinsdottir;101', 'Nanna;101') WHERE ID IN (21245, 21262) AND StartName = 'Anya Vinsdottir'
entries.why: Black Plague and Strange Bedfellows were given by Anya Vinsdottir (a weapon merchant) while the text says Nanna; the period giver is Nanna Vinsdottir, the healer beside her, who is our NPC 'Nanna'
entries.source: Allakhazam quests 1801 Strange Bedfellows (Mid) and Black Plague (Mid): 'Quest begins with Nanna Vinsdottir' / 'go back to Nanna'; CapnBry radar: Nanna Vinsdottir (Healer) Jordheim 26615,22777 = our healer 'Nanna', next to the weapon merchant Anya Vinsdottir

entries.why: the marker follows the giver to Nanna the healer
the marker follows the giver to Nanna the healer

entries.sql: UPDATE DataQuest SET StepText = replace(StepText, 'Volkstad in Dellingstad', 'Vorkald in Dellingstad') WHERE ID BETWEEN 21257 AND 21261
entries.why: the text named 'Volkstad', who does not exist; the Dellingstad NPC who sends the player and takes the whisker is Vorkald (the walkthrough's slip)
entries.source: Allakhazam quest Mammoth Hunt: 'Per Patch 1.62: Vorkald will now give Furry Boned Legs'; CapnBry radar: Vorkald, Delling Crater 20137,59339

entries.sql: UPDATE DataQuest SET SourceName = replace(SourceName, 'SEARCH;9;;23;40960;40960;32768;5', 'SEARCH;9;;23;31814;34328;400;5') WHERE ID BETWEEN 21318 AND 21321
entries.why: 'wear the four relics and stand in the centre of the room' was a search over the whole Catacombs zone; the area is now the centre of the round room of the four Roman standard-bearers (radius 400)
entries.source: Allakhazam quest 187 The Craft of Retribution: 'Once you have all 4 items, wear them and stand in the center of the room'
